title: S122 Simplify Behavior Simulation
methodology: Structural analysis of output patterns by question type and learner context. Compares old behavior (one-line core-sentence echo) to new behavior (4-section plain-language coaching).

scenarios.oldBehavior: Revealed correct answer + 'This question is testing whether you understand [topic]' — NO GATE
scenarios.newBehavior: Concept-only coaching: What this concept is about, Why it matters, How to recognize on exam day, Quick rule. No answer letter, no choice text. Prompts learner to submit first.
scenarios.coachingInsightAdded: Yes — 4-section structural coaching even before answering

scenarios.context: Learner answered A (correct), wants plain-language reinforcement
scenarios.oldBehavior: One-line core sentence + 'This question tests [topic]. The key is knowing the answer is [A]'
scenarios.newBehavior: Full 4-section: What this means (plain language translation), Why it matters (section-aligned significance), How to recognize (recognition tips), Quick rule (memory hook). Correct answer confirmed.
scenarios.coachingInsightAdded: Yes — plain-language translation, significance framing, recognition tips, memory hook

scenarios.context: Learner selected B (wrong), correct is C
scenarios.oldBehavior: Same one-line output regardless of learner choice
scenarios.newBehavior: Full 4-section + 'You chose B — that option reflects a common trap' with Wrong Choices referral. Correct answer C revealed.

scenarios.context: Learner has answered, calculation item with $ in stem
scenarios.oldBehavior: Same flat structure, number-based core sentence picked from ExplanationCorrect
scenarios.newBehavior: Calculation-aware translation: 'you are using numbers from a business scenario to compute a specific value.' Formula detection in Quick Rule. Recognition tips tailored to calculation patterns.
scenarios.coachingInsightAdded: Yes — calc-specific plain-language, formula detection, step-by-step recognition

scenarios.context: ExplanationCorrect is empty, learner in review mode
scenarios.oldBehavior: 'The short answer is [cc]: [choice]. This is about [topic]. If you'd like... tap Explain answer.'
scenarios.newBehavior: Concept framing without fabrication: 'This question tests your understanding of [topic]. In everyday terms: [calc/conceptual framing].' Why it matters and recognition use section-aligned fallbacks. Quick rule uses section-aligned memory hook.
scenarios.coachingInsightAdded: Yes — structural coaching preserved even with thin content, no fabrication

scenarios.context: Session completed, learner reviewing, wants plain-language reminder
scenarios.oldBehavior: Same flat output — no review-mode awareness
scenarios.newBehavior: Full 4-section with review framing: 'Let's break this down in plain language so the concept sticks.' Plain-language translation, significance, recognition, quick rule. Confirms correct answer. Refers to Explain answer for full detail.
scenarios.coachingInsightAdded: Yes — review-mode framing, plain-language depth, Explain referral

antiLeakage.unansweredGate: CONFIRMED — active unanswered questions receive concept-only coaching without answer reveal

antiFabrication.plainLanguageTranslation: CONFIRMED — parenthetical form preserves original alongside plain equivalent

safetyAssessment.meaningDistortion: CONFIRMED — all replacements use parenthetical form (original + plain), never drop original meaning, core concept words preserved in all test cases
